name: managing-revenue-recognition
description: Drafts ASC 606 revenue recognition memos, policy memos, disclosure drafts and audit-ready files from customer contracts, with IFRS 15 differences: contract existence and combination, side letters and side agreements, contract modifications (separate contract, prospective or cumulative catch-up), performance obligations and the series guidance, variable consideration and the constraint, right of return and consignment, significant financing component, standalone selling price (SSP) allocation, principal or agent (gross versus net), bill-and-hold, functional or symbolic IP licenses, ASC 340-40 contract costs and the one-year practical expedient, and remaining performance obligation (RPO) disclosure. Takes revenue recognition policy and ASC 606 / IFRS 15 application questions raised in earnings-quality or QoE work, including ASC 606 recognition conclusions flagged in earnings quality review: bill-and-hold (606-10-55-83), principal or agent, variable consideration and contract modifications. Drafts for review.
